meta.title: Request handling: AI opportunities
meta.subtitle: Where AI could help, marked on the current-state map.

ai.title: Draft the review summary
ai.does: Drafts a summary of each request for Team B to check during review.

cite.quote: We would like AI to draft the review summary

agentic.trigger: Team B opens a logged request for review.
steps: Read the request and its tracker entry.
Draft a short summary of the request.
Attach the draft summary to the tracker entry.

decides.what: reads the summary and edits it before the review

agentic.logging: Each run records the request, the draft summary and the edits Team B made.

ai.title: Read each request into the tracker
ai.does: Reads the request email and fills in the tracker, so Team B no longer logs it by hand.

cite.quote: Logged in the tracker by hand

cite.reading: Logging each request by hand is slow and could be automated

agentic.trigger: A new request arrives by email.
steps: Fill in the tracker fields from the request.
Send the new tracker entry to Team B.

decides.what: checks the entry and accepts it or corrects it

agentic.logging: Each run records the email, the fields it filled and the decision Team B made.

ai.title: Check requests are complete on arrival
ai.does: Checks each request for missing details before review, so fewer requests go back to Team A.

cite.reading: Incomplete requests cause rework for Team A

steps: Read the request and its tracker entry.
Compare the request with the details a review needs.
List any detail that is missing.

decides.what: decides whether the request goes back to Team A

agentic.logging: Each run records the request, the details it found missing and what Team B decided.

ai.title: Keep each request’s history in one place
ai.does: Records every change to a request in the tracker, so each team can see where a request is.

cite.reading: Only the outcome is logged in the tracker today

agentic.trigger: A request changes at any step.
steps: Read the change from the email or the tracker.
Add the change to the request’s history in the tracker.
Show the history to each team that opens the request.

decides.what: checks the history entry and corrects it when it is wrong

agentic.logging: Each run records the change, where it came from and who corrected it.
